prompt: Add `Checkout.pay(cart, code, country, cardToken)` in src/checkout.ts. It applies the coupon `code` from the coupon book, which must refuse an expired coupon with `CouponExpiredError`; adds VAT for the customer's country (20% for "GB", 19% for "DE", 21% for "NL", none elsewhere; more countries will follow); charges the result through `StripeClient.createCharge` in src/stripe-client.ts; and resolves to the charge id. We may add PayPal at some point. `buildCheckout(client)` in src/app.ts must return a ready checkout that charges through `client`.
